thread:
Alex Nguyen: Quick FYI — we're kicking off the v2 telemetry rollout to infra slice A in ~30m. Need infra owners + SDK leads to confirm event names, trace tags, and canary window. TL;DR: telemetry events changed (v2) and we need new tag `v2_route` on requests.

Maria Chen: Which SDK change are we gating on? Is this only new event names, or payload schema too?

Sandeep Rao: I'm infra metrics owner. I'll add a shim to forward old event names for 24h. Need the canonical mapping table and example payloads.

InfraBot: Canary job scheduled: infra-canary-a -> starts 2026-04-01T15:30Z, duration 2h. Runbook: infra/telemetry/canary-runbook.md

Lisa Park: SDK team — the v2 telemetry client renames `route` to `v2_route`. There's a tiny semver bump (0.9.8 -> 0.9.9). Also noticed a formatting regression in `timestamp` field; we have a PR ready but not merged.

Kevin O'Neill: If the shim breaks, what's fallback? Can we route old events to v1 collector until we fix?

Alex Nguyen: Fallback: yes — we can route to v1 collector per policy. Plan: canary start, 30m smoke, then 4x10m ramp steps if no sig alerts. Need approvals from Maria + Sandeep + Lisa. please post :thumbsup: here when ready.

Maria Chen: quick note — upload mapping/table to infra repo under `infra/telemetry/mappings/v2-to-v1.csv` and tag PR with `v2-telemetry-canary`. I'll review.

Sandeep Rao: will own the rollout toggles and alerts. Also add `trace_id` propagation check to smoke. pinging oncall.

Lisa Park: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/542 — contains mapping + timestamp fix. Requesting reviewers @Alex, @Maria.

Kevin O'Neill: I'll monitor logs and paging rules. If error rate >0.5% for 5m -> roll back. Also will watch latency p95.

Alex Nguyen: Sounds good. Final ask: can everyone post their availability window during the canary (15:30Z—17:30Z) and any constraints?

Lisa Park: I'm available whole window :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: available until 16:45Z, then limited.

Sandeep Rao: available whole window, will be on call.

Kevin O'Neill: available, will be watching alerts.

Alex Nguyen: Great — locking schedule. I'll create canary PR and tag owners. Thanks.
